assertions.description: Normal settled EXECUTION_REPORTED impact_review Run supplies an exact bound sealed report; analyze, independent acceptance and apply use real loopback HTTP. No Task ACCEPTED prerequisite.

Deterministic impact identities retained; additional Artifact and downstream Task appended; apply marks the downstream NEEDS_REVALIDATION. Missing key/ETag, changed vector and stale ETag rejected; exact idempotency replay returns identical response.
Eight sealed report/task attacks rejected: wrong proposal/hash, request vector mismatch, duplicate refs, unknown field, first-review predecessor, wrong task type and wrong frozen edit inputs.
Stale-revision, cross-project and VERIFIER_ONLY references rejected without proposal mutation. Restricted reference uses an actual temporary CanaryStore registration.

At analyze/accept/apply, seven current-state fault cases each reject via HTTP (21). Three observation-tamper attempts reject at immutable storage before HTTP. Faults cover executor grant/role, runtime revocation/mode, epoch, policy and stale sealed report.

OPEN conflict remains OPEN and proposal BLOCKED; acceptance rejects. A separate independently accepted/applied resolution resolves it; a new review Run continues without losing earlier impact identities and then independently accepts/applies.
Revoking the earlier review executor after continuation blocks both acceptance and apply, demonstrating historical report-chain revalidation.
Two-level executor and original-author aliases cannot independently accept; revoking the accepted verifier project grant blocks apply.
Existing W15 source-conflict formal resolver regression remains valid, including all-source/task binding, post-resolution usability, skill promotion and subsequent withdrawal refusal.

limitations: Semantic reports are synthetic fixture outputs; neither natural-language completeness nor LIVE semantic correctness is established.
Fixture setup reuses repository factory helpers; independent attack assertions and socket HTTP analyze/accept/apply operations are supplied by the external overlay.
Current-state attack mutations affect temporary SQLite databases only. Observation tamper checks prove immutable storage rejection, not a post-tamper HTTP recheck.
Deterministic and previous semantic impact preservation is by entity identity, with current versions recomputed. No claim that ordinary lifecycle revision advances must preserve obsolete refs.
Only the requested endpoint slice and affected W15 regression were exercised; no full package or whole-W04 completion claim.
